title: PRA process records — handling of the W012462 consolidation
summary:
Asks for records reflecting:

- The Department's handling of an email from the requester to Chief Barberini on 2026-05-06 asking that W012462-040226 be deprioritized,
- Any internal records describing the use of W012462 as a basis for deferring response to other open PRAs, and
- The Department's handling of a 2026-05-07 portal message asking that W012462 be closed.

Named examples in the request body: the 2026-05-06 closure of W012297-030826 into W012462, and the 2026-05-06 extensions of W012373-032026 and W012459-040226 under the same rolling email-search framing.

policy_promises.quote: agency must notify requester within 10 calendar days whether it will produce records
policy_promises.tests: What internal records describe the basis for the 2026-05-06 consolidation and extensions?

prior_pra_refs.note: Records of the handling of W012462 as a consolidation target.
The 2026-05-06 closure of W012297 into W012462.
The 2026-05-06 extension of W012373 under the rolling email-search framing.
The 2026-05-06 extension of W012459 under the rolling email-search framing.

filed_because: Asks the Department for its internal records describing how the 2026-05-06 consolidation and same-day extensions were handled.
notes:
Awaiting initial agency response; 10-day statutory determination due 2026-05-17.

The request's scope note excludes records produced under W012462 itself.
